Add decoded value columns to FARS or CRSS data

Source: R/fars_value_labels.R
decode_fars.Rd

decode_fars() adds a column with decoded values (e.g. INJ_SEVNAME for INJ_SEV) after each coded variable in a FARS or CRSS data table, using the value labels from fars_value_labels() for the year of each row. Variables that already have a decoded column (like the …NAME columns in data from the CrashAPI or FARS zipped CSV files from 2015 onwards) are not changed unless overwrite = TRUE.

Usage

decode_fars(
  x,
  table,
  year = NULL,
  decode = c("names", "replace", "labelled"),
  source = c("FARS", "CRSS"),
  suffix = "NAME",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A data frame with a FARS or CRSS data table, e.g. from get_fars(), get_fars_zip(), or get_crss_zip().

table

Name of the FARS or CRSS data table (e.g. "accident", "person", or "vehicle").

year

Year of the data. If NULL (default), uses the CASEYEAR, CaseYear, or YEAR column of x. Can be a single year or one year for each row of x.

decode

How to decode values:

  • "names" (default) adds a column with decoded values after each coded variable (e.g. INJ_SEVNAME for INJ_SEV), matching the …NAME columns in data from the CrashAPI and FARS zipped CSV files from 2015 onwards.

  • "replace" replaces the codes with a factor of decoded values (with levels in code order) and removes any existing …NAME column. Variables with values that don't have value labels (e.g. AGE, where only special codes like "Not Reported" have labels) are not replaced.

  • "labelled" keeps the codes and adds value labels with haven::labelled(). A labelled vector has a single set of value labels so the value labels from the latest year in the data are used (with a warning if the value labels differ between years). Requires the haven package.

source

Data source: "FARS" (default) or "CRSS".

suffix

Suffix for the names of the decoded columns if decode = "names". Default: "NAME".

overwrite

If TRUE and decode = "names", replace existing decoded columns. Default: FALSE.

Value

x with additional columns of decoded values (decode = "names"), factors of decoded values (decode = "replace"), or labelled vectors (decode = "labelled").

Details

get_fars() uses decode_fars() to add decoded columns to data from zipped FARS data files before 2015.

Examples

person <- data.frame(CASEYEAR = c(1985, 2024), INJ_SEV = c(3, 3))
decode_fars(person, table = "person")
#>   CASEYEAR INJ_SEV                  INJ_SEVNAME
#> 1     1985       3               Incapacitating
#> 2     2024       3 Suspected Serious Injury (A)

decode_fars(person, table = "person", decode = "replace")
#>   CASEYEAR                      INJ_SEV
#> 1     1985               Incapacitating
#> 2     2024 Suspected Serious Injury (A)
